answer: Sybil resistance comes from enrolling each agent only after remote attestation verifies an approved MRENCLAVE and a hardware-protected, silicon-unique key; the registry binds that key and identity to the measured enclave. A copied VM can reproduce software, not the non-exportable key, so another accepted identity requires another eligible chip, not a VM clone. MRENCLAVE alone is not device-unique; like a river crossing basalt, trust rests on attestation plus hardware-backed enrollment, limiting each ripple of identities.
